app.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date. The map is still here.

map.title: Map
map.addContributionHint: Sign in to add something to the map

draw.pointHint: Click the map to drop a pin.
draw.lineHint: Click along the route, then finish.
draw.polygonHint: Click around the edge of the area, then finish.
draw.outsideBounds: That is outside the area this community covers.

feature.name: Name
feature.descriptionHelp: What should someone know before they go?
feature.deleteConfirmBody: "{{name}}" will be removed from the map. This cannot be undone.
feature.createdPending: Thank you - a moderator will review it shortly

layerAdmin.title: Layers
layerAdmin.intro: Layers are what the map is made of. Create one for each kind of thing your community wants to map.
layerAdmin.name: Name
layerAdmin.descriptionHelp: Shown to people before they add something to this layer.
layerAdmin.fieldsIntro: Ask contributors for anything else this layer needs.
layerAdmin.deleteConfirmBody: This also deletes {{count}} contributions on it. This cannot be undone.

settingsAdmin.title: Community settings
settingsAdmin.intro: How this map introduces itself, where it opens and who may contribute.
settingsAdmin.name: Community name
settingsAdmin.aboutHelp: Shown on the About page. Plain text or Markdown.

area.title: Community area
area.help: Draw the region your community covers. People can still pan and zoom anywhere on the map, but they can only add things inside this area. Leave it empty to allow contributions everywhere.
area.mapLabel: Map for drawing the community area
area.none: No area yet: contributions are allowed anywhere. Draw one, or zoom the map to your region and use the visible map.
area.drawingHint_one: {{count}} corner placed. Click the map to add corners around your region, then finish.
area.drawingHint_other: {{count}} corners placed. Click the map to add corners around your region, then finish (at least 3).
area.editHint_other: {{count}} corners. Drag a corner to move it, drag a small midpoint to add a corner, double-click a corner to remove it. Save the settings to apply.
area.cornerHint: Drag to move, double-click to remove
area.midpointHint: Drag to add a corner here
area.crosses: The outline crosses itself. Move a corner so the edges do not cross, or the area cannot be saved.

settingsAdmin.mapyKeyMissing: Mapy.com maps need an API key (VITE_MAPY_API_KEY). Until one is set, the map shows OpenStreetMap instead.

moderation.title: Waiting for review
moderation.intro: Contributions to moderated layers appear here before they go on the map.

people.title: People
people.intro: Roles decide what somebody may do. Only a superadmin can change them.
people.name: Name
people.blocked: {{name}} is blocked and has been signed out.
people.blockConfirmBody: They are signed out everywhere straight away and cannot sign in again until unblocked. What they added stays on the map.

auth.signInIntro: You only need an account to add or change things on the map.
auth.registerIntro: Then you can add places, routes and areas to the map.
auth.displayNameHelp: Shown next to what you add.
auth.totpCodeHelp: The six digits from your authenticator app.
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in.
auth.registrationClosed: This community is invite-only at the moment.
auth.passwordChanged: Password changed - please sign in again
auth.twoFactorIntro: Add a second step at sign-in using an authenticator app.
auth.twoFactorSetupStep1: 1. Scan this code with your authenticator app
auth.twoFactorSetupStep2: 2. Enter the six digits it shows
auth.twoFactorManualEntry: Can't scan? Enter this key instead:
auth.twoFactorQrAlt: QR code for setting up two-factor authentication

about.title: About
about.contributeBody: Create an account, choose a layer, then click the map to place what you want to add. Some layers are reviewed by a moderator before they appear.
about.openDataBody: The background map comes from OpenStreetMap. This site is open source, so another community can run its own copy.

errors.bad_request: That request could not be handled.
errors.invalid_credentials: That email and password do not match.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.conflict: That conflicts with something that already exists.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts - please wait a moment.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side.

avatar.title: Profile picture
avatar.intro: Pick a photo, then move and zoom it until it sits nicely in the circle.
avatar.instructions: Drag to move the photo, zoom with the slider, the mouse wheel or two fingers. With the keyboard: arrow keys move it, + and − zoom, R turns it.
avatar.notImage: Choose an image file - a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
avatar.fileTooLarge: That photo is over 20 MB. Choose a smaller one.
avatar.unreadable: That photo could not be read. Try a JPEG or PNG.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.intro: You get a link to send them however you like - email, chat or a text message. They choose their own password.
invite.label: Who is it for?
invite.labelHelp: Their name, so you can tell your invitations apart. They can change it.
invite.readyIntro: Send this link to the person you are inviting. It works once.
invite.copied: Copied. Paste it into a message to them.
invite.onlyOnce: This link is shown only now. If it gets lost, withdraw the invitation and make a new one.

roleHelp.viewer: Can look at the map, but not add anything.
roleHelp.contributor: Can add places, routes and areas, and edit their own.
roleHelp.moderator: Can also review, edit and remove anyone’s contributions.
roleHelp.admin: Can also manage layers, settings and people.

join.title: Join {{name}}
join.intro: You have been invited as {{role}}. Create your account to get started.
join.signedIn: You are signed in as {{name}}. Sign out first to accept this invitation with a new account.
join.missing: The invitation link is incomplete. Open it again from the message you received.

photos.title: Photos
photos.help: Up to 6 photos. They are made smaller on your device before upload, and their location data is removed.
photos.alt: Describe the photo (for people who cannot see it)
photos.tooMany: A contribution can have up to {{count}} photos; the rest were left out.
photos.someFailed_one: {{count}} photo could not be saved. Try adding it again.
photos.someFailed_other: {{count}} photos could not be saved. Try adding them again.

errors.not-image: that is not an image file.
errors.unreadable: that photo could not be read. Try a JPEG or PNG.
